### Editorial checks
- [ ] Claims are based on first-hand experience or cited sources
- [ ] Egyptian Arabic spelling and tone checked
- [ ] Restaurant and product details verified
- [ ] No AI-generated images; image rights and alt text checked
- [ ] No private reader contact details or API secrets
- [ ] Links and mobile experience checked
- [ ] This publication has received editorial approval

### Deployment
Merging to \`main\` triggers the GitHub Pages workflow and, if enabled in Cloudflare, its connected Pages build.
